Our assessment of manpower requirement is only to provide an equal footing to all the bidders so that they have equal weightage on t his factor. Hence, this tender must not be construed as a tender for supply of manpower or materials. It is also reiterated that this tender is inviting offers to provide maintenance, up keep, sanitation Services and horticulture services and not for supply or deployment of con tract labour and / or materials. Total open area for Housekeeping and Horticulture services is approx. 64168 sqf t. Contractors are advised to survey the area of work before bidding, to avoid an y contention regarding scope of work later on. SCOPE OF WORK AND ATC: 1. Tender is for procurement for Housekeeping & Horticulture Services (Manpower based) fo r the Lawns, Open Area and Common Area at LIC OFFICERS QUARTERS, Jeevan Vihar, 6/32, FREE INDIA HOUSE, Rani Ghat, Kanpur,208001 including manpower, supervision, equ ipment’s and material. 2. Bidders should quote for financial bid (Wages + Housekeeping Material cost + h orticulture work) inclusive of consumables, cleaning material and equipment’s r equired for horticulture service. 3. The bidder must have a local office in the city of Kanpur with a responsible personnel i.e. p oint of contract(POC). 4. Bidder shall bear the cost of all cleaning materials like Harpic, Lizol, Brooms etc. required for the cleaning of the open area, common area (including stairs), and one was hroom. No extra payment shall be given by the LIC for the cleaning material. 5. All tools like lawn movers, rubber pipes, grass cutters other items, etc. and fertilizers as m ay be necessary for proper up keep of horticultural work shall be provided by the bidder. 6. Maintenance of the lawns and of existing plants like trimming, watering, loping, pruning et c. has to be done by the bidder. 7. Sweeping and cleaning (Dry & Wet) of open area and common areas of FIH Campus includ ing collection and disposal of the garbage has to be done by the bidder. 8. The cleaning of open areas has to be done atleast two times on daily basis. 9. Cleaning of lifts, it’s walls and surroundings area to be undertaken on daily basis. 10. All watering, removal of dead and fallen leaves shall be done by the bidder. 11. All the material like fungicide, insecticides or pesticides etc. necessary for healthy growth of plants shall be provided by bidder. 12. The bidder shall plant around 500 seasonal flowering plants as per the requirements by FI H in a year. 13. Collection of garbage from each units of each block(A,B & D) & ensure proper disposal. 14. Staff should wear all the protective clothing and safety gadgets whenever required.

15. The period of contract will be initially for one year from the date of commencement of s ervices/work and can be extended for two years (one year at a time) subject to mutual c onsent of both the parties with same rates and terms and conditions. 16. Corporation reserves the right to cancel or terminate this contract / agreement by giving one month’s notice in writing without giving or assigning any reasons whatsoever for doin g so. In the event of the Contractor wishing to terminate this Contract, the Contractor shall give at least three months’ notice to Corporation in writing and in either case; the Contractor shall hand over the peaceful possession of the space as provided in the tender. The Agency has to provide the house keeping facility till the next agency is engaged (in ca se of termination of contract). 17. After completion of month, the bidder is required to submit the monthly bills, duly verified by the Secretary/President of Free India House welfare Society/Designated officer.The pay ment will be made within 10 days of submission of bill through NEFT. 18. The bidder will provide photo Identity card to the staff which they must display while on d uty. 19. During the course of contract, if any of the bidder’s personnel are found to be indulging in corrupt practices or causing any loss of revenue to LIC. LIC shall be entitled to terminate th e contract forthwith and duly forfeiting the service provider’s performance guarantee. 20. The bidder shall indemnify and hold the LIC protected/safe from and against all claims, da mages, loses and expenses arising out of, or resulting from the works/services under the c ontract provided by the service provider. 21. The bidder will take all safety precautions as per standard Govt. guidelines and they will a lso be responsible and liable for any laxity in this regards. 22. The bidder shall be strictly liable/responsible for complying all the statutory obligations rel ated with Provident fund, ESI and relevant labour laws for its workers deployed on the pre mises of LIC. 23. The bidder shall produce forthwith documents in proof of statutory compliance and paym ent of wages to the deployed workers on being whenever demanded by LIC. 24. The bidder shall provide the Name, Local and Permanent address of the workers deployed for the work in LIC. 25. While discharging the duties, the contractor shall be responsible for any injuries to person s, damage to building, building structure, streets and footpaths and shall rectify it at his o wn cost. 26. In the event that the Life Insurance Corporation of India is held liable under any law to pa y any compensation, damages, or other amount to any employee, workman, agent, or per sonnel of the Bidder on account of any injury, disability, illness, accident, or death caused or sustained during the course of or arising out of the performance of duties at or in conne ction with the premises of the Corporation, the bidder/service provider shall fully indemnif y the Corporation against all such claims, liabilities, payments, losses, damages, penalties, costs, charges, and expenses, including litigation expenses and advocate’s fees incurred b y the Corporation in this regard. 27. The bidder shall not cause or allow any of his personnel to act in any manner, which may cause unnecessary disturbance or inconvenience to the Corporation, employees of the Cor poration, owners / tenants / occupants of nearby properties or to the general public. 28. The bidder shall be responsible for any loss due to theft / pilferage / damage caused in th e course of performance of duties to the Corporation’s property including fittings, furniture , fixtures or any other equipment(s). The Corporation shall assess the amount payable by t he Contractor towards damages / loss / theft / pilferage and the same shall be recovered b y the Corporation from the monthly payment to be made to the Contractor. 29. Courts in Kanpur alone will have exclusive jurisdiction in all matter connected with or arisi ng out of this agreement. 30. The Firm / Agency should be a profitable company during the last 3 financial years, i.e. an

d should have not incurred loss during the last 3 years. 31. In the situation where any manpower’s of contractor is on scheduled leave or absent for a ny reason, vendor has to maintain the number of manpower’s min 4 so as to complete housekeeping service smoothly without any disturbance to its working. 32. If on any day, housekeeping activity is not done at all by the staff. LIC will get the work do ne by any other available alternative and the cost of it will be recovered from the vendor. 33. EMD/Performance bank guarantee will not acquire any Interest over deposited amount. 34. Outsourcing Service provider shall handle data shared by the corporation in such manner as may be specified in the respective agreement to be executed between the outsourcing service provider and L.I.C. Mandatory documents to be uploaded for Technical Qualification of BID- For technical evaluation of bid vendors has to submit documents listed below- 1. Self-attested copy Certificate of Registration of Firm /Company or Certificate of Registr ation under Shop and Establishment Act. 2. Self-attested copy of the labour license. 3. Self-attested copy of the ECIS Registration. 4. Self-attested copy of the EPFO Registration. 5. Self-attested copy of the GST Registration. 6. Copy of the awarded contracts which are presently in operation and Completed contrac ts.( for the last 3 Financial Years 23-24, 24-25, 25-26). 7. Turnover Certificate or Audited financial statements (Income statement, Profit and Loss Account and Balance Sheet) for the last 3 Financial Years. 8. Self-attested copy of the Income Tax assessment order / copy of IT return filed for last t hree Financial Years. 9. Signed copy of Integrity pact. 10. MSME certificate (for MSME vendors) if applying under this category. 11. Declaration regarding for bidder financial standing under non blacklisting, non under li quidation/, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. 12. Details of Office in Kanpur. Important Points- a) EMD will not acquire any Interest over deposited amount. b) The EMD of the unsuccessful bidder shall be refunded within 30 days without any interest. Succes sfully bidder (Contract awarded) has to deposit the performance bank guarantee within 15 days of generation of contract. c) Non- submission of documents referred in Technical bid and Non-disclosure of relevant informatio n or furnishing of incorrect information, documents may result into disqualification. d) The Bidder, who has been declared insolvent/ blacklisted/ prosecuted by any department/ organiz ation in any state or by any court of law, will not be entertained.
